name: Go
summary: Learn Go syntax, slices, interfaces, errors, JSON, and concurrency with the standard library.

lessons.title: Packages, variables, and functions
lessons.explanation: An executable belongs to package main and starts at func main(). Inside a function, := declares a variable and infers its type. Use a named return type after the parameter list.

api.name: fmt.Println()
api.description: Print one or more values and a line break.

api.name: fmt.Printf()
api.description: Format text with verbs such as %d for integers.

api.name: go run file.go
api.description: Build and execute a small main program using an installed Go toolchain.

lessons.practice: Add a discount parameter and calculate totals for two quantities.
lessons.pitfall: Inside a function := must declare at least one new variable in the current block. Use = for plain reassignment.

lessons.title: Branches, loops, slices, and maps
lessons.explanation: Go uses for for all looping forms. A slice describes a segment of an underlying array, and a map stores key-value pairs. range provides positions and values for slices, or keys and values for maps.

api.name: append(slice, value)
api.description: Append an item and return the resulting slice.

api.name: make(map[K]V)
api.description: Create an initialized map.

api.name: delete(m, key)
api.description: Remove an entry when present.

api.name: len(value)
api.description: Read the length of a slice, array, string, or map.

lessons.practice: Add a fourth label and count the distinct names. Check whether a missing name is present.
lessons.pitfall: Assign the slice returned by append. It may refer to a new underlying array.

lessons.title: Structs, methods, and interfaces
lessons.explanation: A struct groups typed fields. Define a method with a receiver before its name. A type satisfies an interface when its method set has the required methods, with no declaration linking them.

api.name: type Name struct { ... }
api.description: Define a type with named fields.

api.name: func (t *T) Method()
api.description: Declare a pointer-receiver method that can mutate T.

api.name: value.(T)
api.description: Assert a dynamic interface type. The two-result form avoids a panic.

lessons.practice: Add a second type that implements Labeled, and print both labels from a slice.
lessons.pitfall: A method with a pointer receiver may require *T rather than T to satisfy an interface.

lessons.title: Multiple results, errors, and defer
lessons.explanation: A common Go signature returns a value and an error. Check the error before using the value. defer schedules a call to run as the current function returns.

api.name: strconv.Atoi(text)
api.description: Parse decimal text into an int or return an error.

api.name: fmt.Errorf("... %w", err)
api.description: Wrap an error with additional context.

api.name: errors.Is(err, target)
api.description: Check a wrapped chain for a matching error.

api.name: defer resource.Close()
api.description: Schedule resource cleanup after successful acquisition.

lessons.practice: Try an invalid value and add a maximum of 100 to positive.
lessons.pitfall: Returning a meaningful error gives callers a choice. Panic is generally unsuitable for expected bad input.

lessons.title: JSON, temporary files, and paths
lessons.explanation: encoding/json converts Go data to and from JSON. Struct fields need exported names to be encoded. Use filepath to construct paths for the current operating system.

api.name: json.Marshal(value)
api.description: Encode a Go value to JSON bytes.

api.name: json.Unmarshal(bytes, &value)
api.description: Decode JSON into the value addressed by a pointer.

api.name: os.ReadFile() / os.WriteFile()
api.description: Read or write the complete contents of a small file.

lessons.practice: Add a second JSON field and print both values after reading the file.
lessons.pitfall: A missing field can leave a zero value. Check required fields explicitly when reading external data.

lessons.title: Goroutines, channels, and coordination
lessons.explanation: Prefix a call with go to run it in a goroutine. Channels pass values between goroutines. Send and receive on an unbuffered channel meet at a synchronization point.

api.name: make(chan T, capacity)
api.description: Create a channel, optionally with room for pending values.

api.name: select { ... }
api.description: Wait for one of several channel operations.

api.name: sync.WaitGroup
api.description: Track tasks that must finish before a caller continues.

api.name: context.Context
api.description: Pass cancellation and deadlines between cooperating operations.

lessons.practice: Launch two workers and receive both results. Notice that completion order can change.
lessons.pitfall: A send can block forever if nobody receives. Design a clear shutdown path for each goroutine.
